active_phases.name: Replace the Claude Design loop with a repo-file design contract and a design subagent
active_phases.objective: Define the on-disk design contract a separate web dashboard reads (each product repo holds its projects, rounds, numbered cards, tokens and decisions in git); add a dedicated design subagent that drafts rounds into it, using frontend-design only where it helps; rewrite design-cowork around the files, retiring the DesignSync read-back and SIGNOFF regroup and keeping Claude Design only as an optional bundle import; reword the executor hard rule to 'the design subagent drafts, the operator decides'; ship a hook that registers a repo with the dashboard. Governance unchanged (styles, rounds, literal signoff, mockup gate, RESPECT THE DESIGN); Claude Code only; no interim viewer (card files are opened directly); the dashboard is built in its own repo.

active_phases.name: Choose the design tool per phase: drafter or Claude Design
active_phases.objective: Let each visual phase choose its design tool at /create-phase (Design tool: drafter | claude-design, drafter by default): design-cowork carries both the P26 drafter loop and the restored original Claude Design loop (no repo mirroring; records under docs/reference/design/claude-design/, skipped by design-* and design-deck), with a legacy-repo migration into that folder, a design-register deck hint, and a v48 bump with a re-sync note

active_phases.name: Nested personal install
active_phases.objective: Let one engineer run this workspace privately inside a host repo they don't own, with no team-visible footprint. The engine and state live in a nested git repo at /workflow, hidden by .git/info/exclude. Skills and executors go into the host's .claude/ as untracked files, with clashing names detected and prefixed at install. Personal settings go in settings.local.json and the contract pointer in CLAUDE.local.md. Nothing is written to CI, .gitattributes or docs/. Slice commits split in two: product code to the host repo in its recorded commit convention (asked once at install), state to /workflow. phase-scope reads the host repo's base commit. Parallel worktrees are off in nested mode. Contract and skill paths carry the /workflow prefix, and an --update path covers nested installs. The acceptance walkthrough waits for a run in the real company repo.

active_phases.name: Nested install by default
active_phases.objective: Make the nested personal install the installer's default layout everywhere (existing repos and fresh dirs, which get git init + nested workflow/); the at-root layout only on --at-root (or --into-existing); --update auto-detects the installed layout from its marker so /update-workspace needs no --nested; existing at-root installs keep updating at-root with no migration; ship as v50.

active_phases.name: Rotate-backlog creates the docs phase by default
active_phases.objective: Change /rotate-backlog so it still archives every clean phase first, then by default turns the phases held back only by doc-consolidation debt into a proposed docs phase: it drafts that phase's name, objective and scope from docs-debt and asks the operator to confirm once; the yes runs new-phase and fills intent.md through create-phase's docs-phase route. An opt-out word (e.g. /rotate-backlog archive-only) keeps today's archive-and-report behavior.
